name: kat-opaquestring

graded_by.test: vault/chain2_test.go — TestOpaqueStringKnownAnswers: reproduces the published vector using the core implementation or independent Go test code for a browser-only step
harness/rigs/vault-vectors.sh — rig-vault-vectors: runs this vector through the deployed browser module in Chromium and requires every selected case to pass

description: The passphrase's bytes: UTF-8 after RFC 8265's OpaqueString profile (credential-protection §4.1): a non-ASCII space becomes the ASCII space, NFC composes a decomposed character, and the profile's disallowed code points (a control character) and the empty string are refused. The corpus asks for a vector with a non-ASCII space and a decomposed character; the fifth case has both. Published e4: reference, graded by U7 and U8c (first) and U6's Go test code (second), tests owed (phase 16).

doc.source: RFC 8265 §4.2 (the OpaqueString profile); RFC 8265 prints no vectors, so these cases were computed with precis-i18n 1.1.2 and checked by hand against §4.2's rules

cases.name: a non-ASCII space (U+00A0) mapped to the ASCII space
an ideographic space (U+3000) mapped to the ASCII space
a decomposed character (e + U+0301) composed by NFC
